oneLine: Thyrocare Technologies sells entire stake in Nueclear Healthcare for 1414 crore.

sources.title: Thyrocare Technologies: Sells Entire Stake in Nueclear Healthcare for ₹1414 Crore

synopsis: Thyrocare Technologies has finalized the sale of its entire 100% shareholding in its wholly-owned subsidiary, Nueclear Healthcare Limited, to Trovera Healthcare Private Limited for approximately 1,414 crore rupees. The transaction consideration comprises 595 crore rupees in Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares from Trovera and approximately 819 crore rupees in cash, subject to working capital adjustments. The Share Purchase Agreement was dated October 30, 2026, following shareholder approval via a postal ballot on October 29, 2026, and a board approval on September 21, 2026. Following the share transfer, Nueclear Healthcare will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Trovera Healthcare.
